OUH Odense Medicinsk Mave-Tarm Afd. S is a healthcare facility recognized as a regional benchmark for postoperative inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) follow-up care in Denmark. The department's performance is tracked by DANIBD, the national quality database for inflammatory bowel diseases, which functions as the core infrastructure for standardized measurement and quality development in IBD care [^src1]. 

The facility is particularly notable for its clinical results regarding [[indikator-3|Indikator 3]], a new quality metric that monitors postoperative colonoscopies following ileocecal resection in patients with Crohn's disease [^src1]. In the first public reporting of this indicator, OUH Odense Medicinsk Mave-Tarm Afd. S stood out among its peers. For departments handling more than 10 patients, it was the only facility to achieve the established development target [^src1]. By reaching an 83% compliance rate for colonoscopies performed within one year, the department successfully surpassed the ≥80% threshold, highlighting excellent clinical practice amid broader national and regional variations in care [^src1].
